Inclusion criteria:
Human population < 18 years of age (infants, children, teenagers) 
OR pregnant women and women in childbearing age
Exposure to lead and methylmercury through HBM/internal exposure data (urine, blood, hair, bones).

Investigating associations between exposure and outcome for single substance or a mixture 
AND reporting regression coefficient and statistical uncertainty

Current exposure of the children (post-natal) OR current exposure of pregnant women (pre-natal).  
Both are considered medium- to long-term timing of exposure.
